identity.name: Lava Mouth

identity.one_line_description: Lava Mouth is a small-batch hot sauce brand making bold, playfully irreverent sauces for heat lovers who eat with personality.

sections.intent: Help undecided visitors navigate the heat spectrum with a clear, fun comparison that removes decision anxiety and turns choosing a sauce into a playful self-discovery moment.
sections.headline: Not Sure Where to Start?
sections.subheadline: Here's how our sauces stack up on the Lava Mouth Heat Scale.
sections.body: We rate our sauces on a five-flame scale that balances heat intensity with flavor complexity. A five-flame sauce isn't just hot — it's hot AND interesting. Use this guide to find your entry point, then work your way up.

items.title: 🔥 Mild
items.description: Flavor-forward, gentle warmth. Perfect for everyday use and heat newcomers.

items.title: 🔥🔥 Medium
items.description: Noticeable heat that builds slowly. Great for those who want more than a whisper.

items.title: 🔥🔥🔥 Hot
items.description: A genuine burn with serious flavor complexity. The sweet spot for most heat lovers.

items.title: 🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥 Extra Hot
items.description: For experienced palates only. Intense, layered, and deeply satisfying if you can handle it.

items.title: 🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥+ Extreme
items.description: You've been warned. This is the frontier. Bring water. Bring a friend.

pages.title: Our Story
pages.goal: Tell the Lava Mouth origin story in a way that makes the brand feel human, earned, and worth rooting for. This is the page that converts casual buyers into loyal fans. The scroll should feel like reading a great short story — deliberate, warm, and surprising.
pages.meta_description: How a backyard obsession with peppers turned into Lava Mouth — the small-batch hot sauce brand built on flavor, fire, and stubbornness.

sections.intent: Open the story with a cinematic, emotionally charged statement that signals this page is different — slower, more personal, worth reading. A deliberate stillness after the energy of the rest of the site.
sections.headline: It Started With a Pepper Plant and a Dare
sections.subheadline: The honest, slightly embarrassing story of how Lava Mouth went from a backyard garden to a bottle on your shelf.

sections.intent: The founding story told in full — personal, funny, and genuine. This section should feel like the founder is talking directly to the reader. Slow, warm, and human.
sections.headline: A Garden, a Blender, and a Very Unhappy Neighbor
sections.body:
In 2018, founder Dani Reyes planted a single row of ghost peppers in her Chicago apartment's community garden plot. By August, she had more peppers than she knew what to do with. By September, she had a blender, a dozen mason jars, and a sauce that her neighbors described as 'aggressively good' and 'slightly dangerous.' By December, she was selling out of a folding table at the Logan Square Farmers Market every Saturday. Nobody was more surprised than Dani.

Lava Mouth wasn't planned. It was grown. The early sauces were made in a rented commercial kitchen from midnight to 4am, labeled by hand at the kitchen table, and sold from the back of a hatchback. Every batch was an experiment. Most were brilliant. A few were spectacular failures that have been sworn to secrecy.

The name came from Dani's nephew, who tried the original ghost pepper sauce at age nine and announced — with tears streaming down his face — that his mouth felt like lava. He asked for more. The name stuck.

items.description: Farmers markets closed. Online sales launched. Discovered that the internet also loves hot sauce, possibly more than anyone expected.

items.title: 2021 — The Shelf
items.description: First regional grocery placement. 25 stockists. Mango Inferno launched and immediately became the best-selling sauce.

items.title: 2022 — The Team
items.description: Hired first two full-time employees. Moved to a dedicated production facility. Still making every batch by hand.

items.title: 2023–Now — The Movement
items.description: 85+ stockists. 40,000+ bottles sold. Six sauces in the permanent lineup. Still small-batch. Always will be.

sections.intent: Articulate the brand's philosophy and values — what Lava Mouth stands for beyond just hot sauce. This section should feel like a manifesto, warm and confident, not corporate.
sections.headline: Flavor First. Heat Second. Always Small-Batch.
sections.body:
A lot of hot sauce brands are in the business of pain. We're in the business of flavor. The heat is real — sometimes brutally so — but every Lava Mouth sauce is built around a flavor profile first. The pepper comes second. That's the rule Dani set in 2018 and it hasn't changed.

Small-batch isn't a marketing phrase for us. It's a hard cap. Every run is 500 bottles or fewer. That means we can adjust recipes based on how the peppers are tasting that season. It means we can try new things without betting the whole company on them. It means every bottle you open is the result of someone's actual attention, not a formula running on autopilot.

We source our peppers from three family farms — two in New Mexico, one in the Yucatán. We've worked with the same growers since year one. When the harvest is good, the sauce is extraordinary. When it's a tough season, we adjust. That's the deal.

sections.intent: A short, human note from Dani — giving the contact page a personal signature that makes the brand feel real and accessible. Deliberate stillness and warmth.
sections.headline: Dani Reads Every Single One
sections.body:
I started Lava Mouth at a kitchen table and I still run it like I'm at that table. Every message that comes in gets read by me or someone on my tiny team. If you're a shop owner thinking about carrying us, a journalist working on a piece, or just someone who wants to tell me what you put Mango Inferno on last night — I genuinely want to hear it.

This is still a small brand. Your message matters.

— Dani Reyes, Founder

sections.headline: Things People Usually Ask Us

items.title: Do you ship directly to customers?
items.description: Not yet — we currently sell exclusively through our retail and wholesale partners. Find your nearest stockist on our Stockists page, or ask your local specialty grocer to carry us.

items.title: Are your sauces gluten-free?
items.description: Yes. All Lava Mouth sauces are gluten-free and made without artificial preservatives. Full ingredient lists are available on each product page.

items.title: How do I become a stockist?
items.description: Fill out the contact form above with 'Wholesale' as your reason, or email wholesale@lavamouthsauce.com. We'll send you a tasting kit and get the conversation started.

items.title: Can I request a custom sauce for an event or restaurant?
items.description: We occasionally take on custom collaboration projects. Reach out via the Collaborations email with your concept and timeline and we'll let you know if it's a fit.

items.title: Where are your peppers sourced?
items.description: We source from three family farms — two in New Mexico and one in the Yucatán, Mexico. We've worked with the same growers since 2019.
